access_log_file.description: Optional path to access-specific log. Leave empty to use main log.

auth_config.description: Path to the authentication backend configuration file.

authentication.description: Enable or disable client authentication (e.g., via PAM, LDAP).

bind_address.description: IP address to bind to. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.

blocked_site_list_config.description: Path to the file containing blocked site domains.

cache_clean_on_start.description: Clean stale cache entries on startup.

cache_dir.description: Path to cache directory for cached objects.

cache_expiry.description: Default cache expiry time in seconds.

cache_free_min.description: Minimum free disk space (MB) required to avoid cache corruption.

cache_max_object_size.description: Maximum size in kilobytes (KB) for individual cached objects.

chain_proxy.description: Enable transparent proxy mode (chain through another proxy).

children.description: Number of worker processes to spawn for handling requests.

clamav_socket.description: Path to ClamAV Unix socket. Use 'disabled' to skip scanning.

client_timeout.description: Idle timeout in seconds for client connections.

content_dlp.description: Enable or disable Data Loss Prevention (e.g., preventing upload of sensitive data).

content_dlp_config.description: Path to DLP rules configuration file.

content_filter.description: Enable or disable content filtering based on patterns/mime types.

content_filter_config.description: Path to the content filtering rules file.

content_scan.description: Enable or disable real-time scanning of downloads for malware.

credit_card_detection.description: Enable or disable detection of credit card numbers in content.

default_language.description: Default language for error and blocking pages (e.g., english, german).

dns_cache.description: Enable or disable internal DNS result caching.

dns_use_tcp.description: Fallback to TCP for DNS queries if UDP fails.

enable_compression.description: Enable or disable GZIP compression for responses.

enable_keepalive.description: Enable or disable HTTP keep-alive connections.

enable_pipelining.description: Enable HTTP request pipelining (may improve performance with compatible servers).

extension_filter.description: Enable or disable filtering based on file extensions.

extension_filter_config.description: Path to file extension filtering rules.

forward_for.description: Enable or disable insertion of X-Forwarded-For header (for client IP transparency).

group_access.description: Enable or disable per-group access control (requires group membership).

group_access_config.description: Path to the group access control rules file.

hsts.description: Enable or disable HTTP Strict Transport Security header injection.

ip_rate_limit.description: Enable or disable rate limiting per source IP address.

ip_rate_limit_max.description: Max allowed requests per IP per minute (if IP rate limiting enabled).

keep_alive_timeout.description: Time (seconds) to keep idle connections alive.

language_detect.description: Enable automatic language detection via Accept-Language header.

language_path.description: Path to directory containing language template files.

log_custom_format.description: Custom log format string (only used if log_format=3).

log_file.description: Path to the main log file.

log_level.description: Verbosity level for logging (0–4). Higher = more verbose.

log_rotate_compress.description: Compress rotated log files with gzip.

log_rotate_count.description: Number of rotated log files to keep.

log_rotate_size.description: Maximum log file size (MB) before rotation.

log_to_syslog.description: Enable or disable sending logs to the system syslog daemon.

max_body_lines.description: Maximum number of HTTP body lines to parse.

max_conn_per_child.description: Max concurrent connections per worker process.

max_header_lines.description: Maximum number of HTTP header lines to parse.

max_req_per_conn.description: Max HTTP requests per keep-alive connection.

mime_filter.description: Enable or disable filtering based on MIME types.

mime_filter_config.description: Path to MIME type filtering rules.

object_cache.description: Enable or disable local HTTP object caching.

password_leakage.description: Enable or disable detection of password leakage in uploads.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the main process.

port.description: The TCP port on which the proxy listens for HTTP connections.

prevent_dir_traversal.description: Enable or disable protection against path traversal attacks.

prevent_http_smuggling.description: Enable or disable protection against HTTP request smuggling.

prevent_ssrf.description: Enable or disable protection against Server-Side Request Forgery.

prevent_xxe.description: Enable or disable protection against XML External Entity attacks.

referrer_filter.description: Enable or disable filtering based on HTTP referer headers.

regex_filter.description: Enable or disable advanced regex-based filtering rules.

regex_filter_config.description: Path to the regex filtering rules file.

round_robin.description: Enable round-robin load-balancing across multiple upstream proxies.

run_as_group.description: System group to drop privileges to after startup.

run_as_user.description: System user to drop privileges to after startup (for security).

so_reuse_port.description: Enable SO_REUSEPORT for better multi-thread scaling (Linux ≥3.9).

ssl_ca.description: Path to CA certificate for signing intercepted SSL certificates.

ssl_ca_key.description: Path to CA private key for signing intercepted SSL certificates.

ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL certificate (PEM format). Required if SSL interception is enabled.

ssl_intercept.description: Enable or disable SSL/TLS traffic interception (man-in-the-middle).

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL private key (PEM format). Required if SSL interception is enabled.

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility to use when logging to syslog (e.g., daemon, local0).

tcp_defer_accept.description: Enable TCP_DEFER_ACCEPT to delay accept until data arrives (Linux only).

tcp_no_delay.description: Enable TCP_NODELAY (disables Nagle’s algorithm) for lower latency.

upstream_proxy_auth.description: Enable authentication to the upstream proxy.

upstream_proxy_host.description: Host:port of upstream proxy for chaining (if used).

upstream_proxy_password.description: Password for upstream proxy auth (if enabled).

upstream_proxy_port.description: Port of upstream proxy (if host specified).

upstream_proxy_username.description: Username for upstream proxy auth (if enabled).

url_filter.description: Enable or disable URL-based filtering (blacklists, keywords).

url_filter_config.description: Path to the URL filtering configuration file.

user_agent_filter.description: Enable or disable filtering based on User-Agent headers.

user_rate_limit.description: Enable or disable rate limiting per authenticated user.

user_rate_limit_max.description: Max allowed requests per user per minute (if user rate limiting enabled).

web_admin.description: Enable or disable the web-based admin interface.

web_admin_config_edit.description: Allow live editing of config via admin interface.

web_admin_log_access.description: Allow admin interface users to view logs.

web_admin_password.description: Enable or disable password protection for the admin interface.

web_admin_port.description: Port for the admin interface (if enabled).

web_admin_reports.description: Enable or disable report generation via admin interface.

web_admin_user_list.description: Path to file listing admin usernames/passwords.

whitelist_site_list_config.description: Path to the file containing whitelisted (allowed) domains.
